$comment: Default holder-tier settings for any project whose config/projects/<slug>.json has no `holders` block (or omits a field). These are TEL's historical values, sized for a 100B supply — a project with a very different supply should set its own `holders` block. Ranges: `max: null` means no upper bound. `distributionTiers` labels are JOIN KEYS into holder-transitions.json / tier-outflows.json / holders-history.json and must stay stable once a project has data; order is largest -> smallest. `balanceRanges` order is smallest -> largest. Read by scripts/lib/holderTiers.js (pipelines) and src/lib/holderTiers.ts (UI).
